title: Libre2 sensor changes not uploaded to Nightscout
body:
Two minor problems I encountered when I changed my Libre2 sensor:

- xDrip (20191122 if that matters) FCs when the new sensor is detected by LibreLink (patched)
- xDrip never sends a "Sensor Change" treatment record to Nightscout (although the new sensor is listed in System Status)

Both can be mitigated, the first by restarting the app, the second by extracting the start date from LL data and uploading a corresponding JSON record, but it's a minor nuisance every two weeks...

comments.body: The first bullet point may have an explanation - the settings allow xDrip to fail if it detects a sensor ID change. Is the second item related (i.e., the change isn't reported due to xDrip restarting)?

For the sensor ID change, I think you could simply disable the setting "check libre serial" in settings-->less common settings. This should fix the issue of ID changes included in your first bulletpoint

@yosepito done that - still I'm lacking sensor changes reported to NS. (I have a way to extract the last sensor serials from LL's database and upload them, but it's kind of a nuisance.)
Also, recently xDrip does no longer remember previous sensors (the "Sensors:" list in System Status > Libre2 is empty; only the current one s shown as "Libre2 Sensor:"). Running latest nightly.

@steve8x8 Are you still having problems with xDrip?
Have you asked in the Gitter room to see what others may be doing in a similar situation?
